# COMBO_07 · Electric Flash Explosion (standard approximation for an unmatched element)

## 1. Search Summary (embedding target)

Electric Flash Explosion (standard approximation for an unmatched element). A shock / lightning explosion. The standard response when no dedicated electric source exists. Representative prompt: "Make an explosion effect with electricity crackling". A white smoke carrier plus a triple stack of cyan / blue light (#42FFF5, #58BFFF, #81AEFF). Composition: Base SmokeBurst_A / Detail NeutralPulse_R_A, LightBurst_R_A, LightShimmer_A / Extra none. Duration 2s. Related vocabulary: electric, electricity, lightning, thunder, shock, zap, arc, discharge, spark, burst, explosion, cyan, blue, 전기, 번개, 뇌전, 감전, 스파크, 방전, 번쩍, 섬광, 폭발, 에너지, 파랑, 시안, 전격.

## 3. Composition Structure

| Layer | Source | Spawn | Size | Speed | Delay | Color (start -> end) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base | SmokeBurst_A | burst 5 | 1 | 5 | 0 | #F9EADA -> #555351 |
| Detail | NeutralPulse_R_A | rate 10/s x 0.5s | 1 | - | 0 | #58BFFF -> #071649 |
| Detail | LightBurst_R_A | rate 8/s x 1s | 1 | 1 | 0 | #42FFF5 -> #30CEFF |
| Detail | LightShimmer_A | burst 10 | 1 | 1 | 0 | #81AEFF -> #353BD3 |

- Layer usage: Base 1 / Detail 3 / Extra 0 (4 sources total)
- Playback: `AutoActivate` True / `InfiniteLoop` False / `LoopCount` 1
- `LoopDuration` **2s** — read-only derived value. Cannot be set directly.
  - Determining factor: `SmokeBurst_A` (approx. 2.0s) is the maximum. The rate sources run 0.5s and 1.0s

## 4. Design Rationale (Why This Combination)

1. The source catalog has no dedicated electric or lightning asset. In that case, approximate with a visual carrier Base plus an element Detail stack rather than falling back to Neutral
2. `SmokeBurst_A` is not there to draw smoke; it is a carrier supplying the explosion volume and silhouette
3. The electric feel comes from three Detail sources dividing the work: `LightBurst_R_A` (rate 8/s, arc flashes), `NeutralPulse_R_A` (rate 10/s, pulsing), `LightShimmer_A` (burst 10, residual sparks)
4. Color decides the element. Recolor this same structure to orange and it becomes a flame explosion outright

## 5. Applied Composition Patterns

- `unmatched_element_fallback` — Approximation for an unmatched element (not a Neutral fallback)
- `smoke_carrier_base` — Smoke Base repurposed as a visual carrier
- `light_detail_stack` — Multiple stacked Light-family Details

## 7. Adaptation Guide (for the Agent)

- Electric intensity: raise `LightBurst_R_A` SpawnRate (8/s) and push Color toward a brighter #7FFFFF
- The Base/Detail skeleton is nearly identical to Combo_04. Treat the two recipes as variants of each other
- To hide the carrier smoke, raise `SmokeBurst_A` Transparency above 0.7 (removing it destroys the explosion silhouette)
